replies.R044: For a uniformly charged sphere V(r)=kQ/R · (3/2−r³/2R³); at r=R/2 this gives V=1.5·kQ/R and at the surface V=kQ/R, so the difference is 0.5·kQ/R = 14 V. Hence the correct potential difference is 14 V.
